data.title: Shift the event position in GaussSmearVertex and FlatSmearVertex so that beam particles are smeared too
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- `GaussSmearVertex`, `FlatSmearVertex`: shift the event position together with the vertices, so that beam particles start at the smeared interaction point instead of (0,0,0). Fixes #63.

ENDRELEASENOTES

The smearing tools shifted each vertex in `GenEvent::vertices()`. The beam particles come out of the HepMC3 root vertex, whose position is the event position. The root vertex is not in that list, so the beams stayed at (0,0,0) while everything else moved. `GenEvent::shift_position_by` shifts the event position and all vertices. Vertices without an explicit position take theirs from the (shifted) event position or their parent vertex, so they end up where they were before.

data.author: scott-snyder
data.body:
PairCaloClustersPi0 tries to find all pairs of clusters with invariant mass consistent with the pi0 mass, subject to the constraint that no cluster is used by more than one pair.  It was doing this combinatoric problem by exhaustive search, which was exponential in both space and time. Boost.graph supplies an algorithm (Galil, https://doi.org/10.1145/6462.6502) that solves this in N^3 time (and i think linear space). Rewrite this algorithm to use this.

data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
The downstream-build has been broken since changing to the LCG stacks, time to fix it.

 - Get the packages to build in the downstream build from the LCG nightlies (`LCG_externals_<platform>.txt` of the release behind the sourced LCG view) instead of Spack
